lifecycle.summary: Initialize resets bounded state, writes 1.0f to field_514C/field_5150, allocates a 4096-object main cell pool, and initializes visible background bounds.
A matching avatar reference is cleared, old graphics and associated objects are released, a scale change triggers rebuild, and the pool object is recreated.
The SDK labels the function cGameData::Write, while the recovered body has destructor/teardown mechanics and a global reference decrement; the conflict is preserved.
The noun-map path performs map lookup/materialization, may invoke callback-shaped helpers, and clears the tGameDataVectorT needsUpdate word.
The first word of each cCellObjectData links free objects; allocation replaces the link with the object index and release restores the free-list head and idle flag.
The vtable names initialization/disposal, subsystem initialization/disposal, update, and post-update slots; concrete call order is not runtime-observed here.
